requestedActions.title: Connect an individual Todoist account via OAuth
List active task titles for the connected account, including pagination

guide.summary: Todoist documents user-authorized OAuth2 authorization-code flow for external apps to obtain user-scoped API tokens. Read-only listing of active tasks can use the documented data:read scope, which grants read-only access to tasks. Pagination uses cursor-based next_cursor on the tasks endpoint. Pagination details and endpoint coverage are recorded in coverage; no write scope is needed for the confirmed read-only request.

Pagination details and endpoint coverage are recorded in coverage; no write scope is needed for the confirmed read-only request.
